title: GR Recovery in Energy-Flow Cosmology via Density Saturation: Quantitative PPN Analysis for the Solar System
abstract: Derives the Solar System post-Newtonian limit of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) and shows that the modified Einstein equation acts as a scalar rescaling of GN, yielding Φ = Ψ and thus γ = 1 at linear order. Introduces a precise effective-density definition for the density saturation gate and demonstrates that dual screening (acceleration- and density-based) suppresses EFC modifications by 4–8 orders of magnitude below the Cassini bound.
